outcome: placental protein expressions (PI3K p110a, LXRa, FAS, SCD1, LPL, PPARa, PPARg)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of pregnant women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and control pregnant women (CPW), from whom maternal blood, cord blood, and placental samples were collected.
finding: GDM women showed significantly higher placental expressions of PI3K p110a, LXRa, FAS, SCD1, and LPL, lower PPARa and PPARg expressions, increased placental TG content, and increased cord plasma FFA compared to CPW, with placental TG content positively correlating with the Ponderal index of GDM newborns.
birth_weight: Ponderal index of GDM new-borns, fetal overgrowth
